title: http.cookiejar.domain_match() matches an interior substring instead of a suffix
author: metsw24-max
body_preview: `domain_match(A, B)` is documented to return True when A has the form NB, i.e. A ends with B (RFC 2965, section 1: "x.y.com domain-matches .Y.com but not Y.com").
